limits: Correct integration, completed smoke and useful learned policies are different outcomes.
One training seed and 64 decisions do not establish comparative learning performance.
Control returns preserve complete/horizon scopes and are not independent training seeds.
No raw-score average across games; no equivalence claim from degenerate intervals.
Clipped training reward and raw evaluation score are not identical objectives.
Measured active phases exclude queue/startup; cell sums are not parallel calendar time.
Observed RSS and small-smoke times do not bound a long campaign.
Linux preflight and compatible cost measurements are still required.
A6/A7 review, resolved protocol, long authorization, development selection and explicit test authorization remain pending.
